name: 透明水光玻璃唇唇釉款
description: 透明唇釉水光质感，七镜覆盖上嘴试色、质地与开箱信任

styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat seamless paper only: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and grids, pale mist grey #E6E8E7 for the single-product and flat-lay frames, soft ivory #F5F1EC for texture and macro frames; deep navy #2B3A55 reserved for label plates and bands
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright neutral 5500K studio light, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill, controlled wet specular on the lip surface, soft contact shadow under every upright product, no hard falloff
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep in #FFFFFF / #E6E8E7, plus one sheet of pale glossy acrylic #F5F1EC used only to carry formula smears
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most one small label line per frame; every wording slot is a placeholder, never source wording
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks and empty unbranded circular seal outlines left as reserved proof placeholders
styleLock.presentationRules: the product stands upright at a stable scale; every lip frame is cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person; comparison and variant grids keep identical framing, camera height and light in every tile
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between grid tiles
no platform, marketplace or certification badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean glossy lip colour ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, soft ivory #F5F1EC, pale mist grey #E6E8E7 and deep navy #2B3A55 for label plates, with one product-matched accent; bright neutral 5500K studio lighting, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill, controlled wet specular and soft contact shadows; flat seamless paper backgrounds only, no environmental sets; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline and one small label maximum, every wording slot carried by a placeholder; thin single-weight line marks and empty unbranded seal outlines; product upright at a stable scale, all lip frames cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person; identical framing and light across grid tiles; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no platform or certification badges.

shots.intent: 搜索结果页一眼点击，产品与外盒并列的干净白底承接首图流量
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, both units standing upright, full silhouettes inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key 5500K studio light, large soft front-left key with low-contrast fill card, soft contact shadows
shots.props: the product's own upright carton standing beside it
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond an even clean margin around the silhouettes
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product stands upright centre-right, photographed straight-on at eye level with its carton standing beside it, both silhouettes fully inside the frame. Bright even high-key 5500K studio light, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both units on seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin all around and no extra whitespace. Square marketplace main image, crisp edges, true material rendering. Negative: no props beyond the product's own carton, no hands, no watermark, no invented badge or seal, no garbled or invented lettering on the packaging faces, no platform or marketplace logo, no star ratings, no gradient or textured background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒说清透明水光的主张，用极简竖版单品承接首图后的利益层
shots.camera: very low angle looking slightly upward along the tall slim upright product
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with a gentle rim sweeping one product edge, low-contrast fill, soft contact shadow at the base
shots.background: flat pale mist grey #E6E8E7 seamless paper
shots.whitespace: generous negative space kept across the upper 40% of the frame for copy
shots.textZone: upper 40% clean band on the pale grey field, one short headline only
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product reads as a tall slim upright silhouette placed low in the centre of the frame, photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward so the vertical line stays clean against a flat field. Soft front-left key with a gentle rim sweeping along one product edge, low-contrast fill, and a soft contact shadow pooling at the base. Flat pale mist grey #E6E8E7 seamless paper background. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space across the upper 40% reserved for a single short headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in deep navy #2B3A55, modern geometric sans-serif, and one thin hairline rule in {accent_color}. Negative: no second claim, no dense body text, no ingredient naming, no wording outside the single headline placeholder, no props, no hands, no watermark, no invented seal or badge.

shots.intent: 让买家在对号肤色的裸唇特写里代入自己，建立对上嘴光泽的信任
shots.camera: matched straight-on frontal close crops of the lower face, identical distance and crop in every tile
shots.lighting: one identical soft front key at 5500K per tile, wet specular along the lip surface, no hard shadow
shots.background: seamless white #FFFFFF field with clean hairline gutters
shots.whitespace: clean white gutters between tiles and generous whitespace inside the blank copy tile
shots.textZone: fourth tile, lower right, held as one clean copy panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce four-tile wear grid showing {product} applied. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three matched straight-on frontal close crops of the lower face only, each cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person, on three different natural skin tones, lips relaxed and slightly parted so the clear coating reads as wet light. One identical soft front key at 5500K in every tile, wet specular on the lip surface, no hard shadow, real skin texture kept. Tiles sit on a seamless white #FFFFFF field separated by clean hairline gutters; the worn lips occupy 40-50% of the frame overall and the fourth tile stays a blank pale panel with generous negative space reserved for one short line reading 「{callout_1}」 in deep navy #2B3A55. Negative: no eyes, no full face, no recognizable likeness, no plastic over-smoothed skin, no erased lip texture, no duplicated tile, no wording other than the single callout placeholder, no watermark, no invented shade name.

shots.intent: 用微距证明质地与刷头贴合，消掉粘腻与卡纹的顾虑
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro square to the mouth at a slight high angle about 25 degrees above eye level, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: bright neutral key sweeping across the surface from the upper left, fine skin detail kept, soft shadow under the applicator
shots.background: soft ivory #F5F1EC seamless paper edge framing the crop
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the macro detail itself is the subject
shots.textZone: lower edge band on a solid deep navy #2B3A55 plate for one short line
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} being applied, tight zoom on the lips and the doe-foot applicator. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera square to the mouth at a slight high angle about 25 degrees above eye level, shallow depth of field with the lip centre sharp and the surrounding skin falling off softly. The applicator enters from below the frame and its tip touches the centre of the lower lip; the face stays cropped from the philtrum to the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person. Bright neutral key light sweeping across the surface from the upper left to render the wet gloss texture, real skin detail preserved, a soft shadow under the applicator. The crop sits framed on a soft ivory #F5F1EC seamless paper edge. The macro detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace, and a solid deep navy #2B3A55 plate runs along the lower edge reserved for one short line reading 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no extra or fused fingers, no hand visible in frame, no blurry subject, no roundel or badge implying a platform or marketplace, no star ratings, no dense body text, no fabricated result, no watermark.

shots.intent: 同机位同光的九宫矩阵呈现唇面状态差异，先放大痛点再给出结果证明
shots.camera: matched straight-on frontal close crops, identical framing, camera height and distance in all nine tiles
shots.lighting: one identical soft front key at 5500K on every tile so only the lip state differs, wet specular on coated tiles only
shots.background: seamless white #FFFFFF with thin white gutters
shots.whitespace: thin gutter spacing only plus one blank header row above the grid
shots.textZone: three blank header plates above the grid columns
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison grid for {product}: a three-by-three matrix of matched straight-on frontal close crops of the lower face only, each cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left column bare untreated lips, middle column freshly coated, right column after continued use, with identical framing, distance, camera height and one soft front key at 5500K in every tile so only the lip state changes and the lighting never drifts. Skin texture stays real, with a wet gloss specular on the coated tiles only. Thin white gutters on a seamless white #FFFFFF field; the coated results occupy 50-60% per column, and one blank deep navy #2B3A55 header plate sits above each column reserved for the three short stage labels 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」. Negative: no numbers, no dates or time values, no percentages, no clinical or test wording, no exaggerated or fabricated results, no mirrored or duplicated tiles, no face identity, no competitor product, no watermark.

shots.intent: 给出选号入口，把无色透明款放在首格并铺出整个色号家族
shots.camera: checkerboard grid pairing matched straight-on lower-face wear crops with top-down flat texture smears
shots.lighting: identical soft front key at 5500K on every wear tile and one even top light on every smear tile, no lighting drift
shots.background: soft ivory #F5F1EC field with hairline gutters
shots.props: a sheet of pale glossy acrylic carrying the texture smears
shots.whitespace: hairline gutters only, no extra whitespace around the grid
shots.textZone: one small blank label plate per tile for a generic shade name
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant shade grid of {product}: a dense checkerboard that pairs matched straight-on close crops of the lower face only, cropped from the tip of the nose to the chin with no eyes and no identifiable person, with top-down flat smears of the same formula laid on pale glossy acrylic. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One identical soft front key at 5500K on every wear tile and one even top light on every smear tile, so finish and tint differences read without any lighting drift. Tiles sit edge to edge on a soft ivory #F5F1EC field divided by hairline gutters; the grid occupies 70-80% of the frame overall, the first tile is the untinted clear finish, and each tile carries a small blank label plate lettered in {accent_color} reserved for a generic shade name such as 「{callout_6}」. Negative: no invented shade names, no trademark style naming, no mixed lighting between tiles, no duplicated face or duplicated lips, no wording beyond the blank label plates, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 平铺外盒各面与管身刷头，交付开箱预期并降低下单风险
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: bright even high-key light from directly above, minimal soft shadows, no dramatic falloff
shots.background: flat pale mist grey #E6E8E7 seamless paper
shots.props: the product's own carton, cap and applicator laid on the grid
shots.whitespace: generous even margins around the aligned layout
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust flat lay: {product} laid out from directly above with its carton shown across the front, side and back faces, the cap removed and the applicator resting beside it, all items aligned on a quiet grid. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with bright even high-key light, minimal soft shadows and no dramatic falloff. Packaging faces keep only the product's own existing artwork, with dense body copy replaced by a soft blank text block, no barcode shown, no web address, no certification or animal marks; the only graphics are empty unbranded circular seal outlines left as reserved proof placeholders. Flat pale mist grey #E6E8E7 seamless paper surface, the whole layout occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous even margins. Negative: no invented certifications, awards or test seals, no readable wording invented on any packaging face, no barcode, no web address, no platform badge, no duplicated unit, no floating parts without contact shadow, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 7 张参考主图逐图事实：①白底管身与长方外盒并列 packshot；②单品立于浅灰底的极简竖版构图；③四格唇部特写（三种肤色上嘴＋一块字标面板）；④异形刷头触唇微距，含圆形平台角标与底部横幅字样；⑤三乘三裸唇与涂后矩阵，含三列带时间数值的表头；⑥全色号试色棋盘，含色名与品牌面板；⑦外盒各面与管身刷头全家福俯视平铺，密排说明文字与条码。品类判定：产品以涂后无色玻璃光泽妆效售卖，属着色彩妆而非护理，故取 美妆彩妆／唇部，leaf 定为透明水光唇釉；参考类目路径与此一致，未改判。已剥离：品牌字标与系列名、店铺与网址字样、平台徽章与圆形角标、全部图内原文案与色号名、外盒密排说明文字／条码／认证与动物标识、一切即时与长期功效主张及时间数值（一律改为空白 callout 位与空印章框）、唇部特写的身份特征（每镜写明鼻下裁切、无眼、无可辨识面容）。产品一律以 {product} 占位，仅保留分镜结构、机位、光位与色板。
